author: RexRegulus
body:
Two elemental damage boosts with no conflicting maluses... Looks pretty juicy for using Ultima or Ultimastrikes.

Ornate amities will come with 3 bonuses and 3 maluses and it's quite lucky to get an Ornate version on the first try. Gotta have a lot of spare Diluted Mnemonics to farm for one, otherwise.
